residential.methodology: Hedonic/repeat-transaction price index built from ~300,000 real property transactions per year (registry-based), base year 2010=100.
residential.postponement_notice: MLIT announced on 2026-08-27 (令和8年8月27日) that publication of the 不動産価格指数 (Real Estate Price Index) is POSTPONED due to a program bug discovered during index calculation, affecting Jan-Apr 2026 monthly data and the May 2026 / Q1 2026 release onward. No new publication date has been announced as of this fetch. The latest data below (residential through Dec 2025, commercial through Q4 2025) is genuinely MLIT's most recent published figure, not a stale pull — re-run this script by hand once MLIT lifts the postponement to pick up newer data automatically.

reins_market_watch.publication_lag: published ~10th-12th of the month following the data month
reins_market_watch.format_note: Report layout changed starting the 2025-05 data month: pre-2025-05 ('Era 1') gives count/price/price-per-sqm/area/age with YoY% only, no clean inventory figure on page 1; 2025-05 onward ('Era 2') adds a clean inventory (在庫) count + YoY% and MoM% for count/price/price-per-sqm. Series below are a single merged monthly time series per field; MoM% and inventory fields are null before 2025-05 (not published in a reliably-extractable form pre-2025-05 — left null rather than guessed). Earliest available report at this URL pattern is 2014-04 (2014-01/02/03 and earlier all 404).
